faqs.question: How long does shipping from Italy to the USA typically take?
faqs.answer: Air Express targets 2-5 business days after export acceptance, and Air Economy targets 5-10 business days. Ocean Freight (LCL) is schedule-based, with exact sailing and transit shown when you request a quote.

faqs.question: Do you handle US Customs clearance?
faqs.answer: The platform guides you through commercial invoice and customs data as part of booking. Any required customs brokerage support is confirmed during operations review.

faqs.question: Are my shipments insured?
faqs.answer: Online payment and checkout-based insurance are not part of the current operating model. Any required commercial settlement or protection terms are handled directly by Nauterio operations.

faqs.question: Can I track my shipment in real-time?
faqs.answer: You'll receive milestone updates from pickup through delivery on the tracking page. Carrier-specific updates are added as each shipment is reviewed and handled by operations.

faqs.question: What types of goods can you ship?
faqs.answer: We support commercial and personal goods subject to operational review, partner coverage and legal restrictions. If a destination or item needs special handling, operations will confirm before accepting the shipment.
